# temps_webhook (Resource)

Delivers a project's events (deployments, domains and more) to an HTTP endpoint.

Temps resolves the host when the webhook is saved and refuses private, loopback and cloud metadata addresses unless an administrator trusts that network. The `temps_webhook_event_types` data source lists valid events.

Import with `<project_id>/<webhook_id>`; `secret` cannot be read back, so set it again after importing.

Required API key permissions: `webhooks:read`, `webhooks:create`, `webhooks:write`, `webhooks:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "temps_webhook" "deploys" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  url        = "https://hooks.example.com/temps"
  events     = ["deployment.succeeded", "deployment.failed"]
  secret     = var.webhook_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Event types to deliver, for example `deployment.succeeded`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `url` (String) Endpoint that receives a POST per event.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. Defaults to `true`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Key used to sign each delivery. Write-only on the server; the API cannot remove it once set, so removing it replaces the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `has_secret` (Boolean) Whether the server holds a signing secret.
- `id` (String) Numeric webhook ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_webhook.deploys 3/7
```
